slides.title: skills.sh - directory of skills skills.sh - stores
slides.text: skills.sh - directory of skills skills.sh - stores URLs/references to GitHub repositories https://skills.sh https://skills.sh/docs A web directory, leaderboard, and finder for skills - I counted 6574 skills. Each skill is essentially a Markdown file. It starts with two lines (name and description) followed by markdown text. Each skill may also have optional bundled resources - scripts, references, assets, examples. bigquery-skill/ ├── SKILL.md └── reference/ ├── finance.md ├── sales.md ├── product.md └── marketing.md You can install using "npx skills add" command, for example: npx skills add https://github.com/remotion-dev/skills --skill remotion-best-practices npx skills add https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-skills --skill web-design-guidelines You need to provide the Github URL and the skill name During installation it finds your agents (for example, Claude Code) and asks where to install (typically to ~/.claude/skills/) Progressive loading (only 50 tokens per header) - allows developers to have hundreds of skills active without overwhelming the context window This makes it significantly lighter than traditional MCP servers The skills.sh has a leaderboard that ranks skills based on anonymous telemetry data from CLI installations

slides.title: AI Updates Cline vs Claude Code AI coding
slides.text: AI Updates Cline vs Claude Code AI coding assistants Cline is VS Code  extension. Claude Code is primarily a terminal app, good for scripting actions and for team work Cline was around for approx 1.5 year and has estimated 4 Mln users; it is free and open source Claude Code user-base is MUCH  bigger. The 3 largest AI assistants are: GitHub Copilot, Cursor (by Anysphere), Claude Code Claude Code also has become available as a VS Code extension (Jan 20th) - and already has more than 3 Mln downloads - more than Cline. Block's open-source Goose vs Claude Code https://github.com/block/goose - more than 27K GitHub stars https://block.github.io/goose/ https://block.github.io/goose/docs/quickstart/ https://block.github.io/goose/docs/getting-started/installation/ Goose is available as both a desktop application and CLI tool , supporting macOS, Linux, and Windows. Supports variety of models You can install Goose via download script or Homebrew: curl -fsSL https://github.com/block/goose/releases/download/stable/download_cli.sh | bash brew install --cask block-goose brew install block-goose-cli No subscription fees, no cloud dependencies, no usage limits

slides.title: AI Updates Stack Overflow - Rapid Decline Its
slides.text: AI Updates Stack Overflow - Rapid Decline Its massive repository of public coding knowledge was used to train the very AI models that have now replaced it Since late 2022, developers have pivoted from searching message boards to using AI agents and LLMs for instant, personalized debugging and code generation The founders sold the platform for $1.8 Bln in 2021, just before the AI boom decimated its traffic and value As developers use AI to generate code, compile, debug, and test it - this data is used by AI providers to train the models instead of human posts GLM-4.7 Flash - Lightweight and Free High-speed coding, agent building, and UI generation Reasoning ("interleaved" and "preserved" thinking) Impressive 59% on SWE-bench Verified (full version ~74%) 30B MoE architecture, lightning-fast responses, handles long-context tasks without losing accuracy Practical Use Cases - coding, AI Agents, UI Generation Can be accessed via the Z.ai API (with a free tier) or deploy it locally using weights from Hugging Face for complete privacy and zero latency Baidu ERNIE 5.0 Native omni-modal large model 2.4T-parama MoE, under 3% active params https://x.com/Baidu_Inc/status/2014252300018254054

slides.title: AI Updates Anti-gravity Update - Skill Builder capability
slides.text: AI Updates Anti-gravity Update - Skill Builder capability Teach AI agents custom workflows using a single prompt The agent observes a user’s actions once, captures the pattern, and saves it as a reusable skill Zero Coding, Dynamic Learning (skills adapt to inputs), chaining multiple skills to create automated end-to-end business processes Users can tag specific agents (e.g., @frontend-design) to generate superior, modern code compared to standard prompts Notebook LM Integration: A new research skill that allows Anti-gravity to query Google Notebook LM URLs for specific data extraction. Loki Mode: An autonomous system that dispatches parallel agents to handle planning, architecture, and verification. Deployment: Easy integration with platforms like Vercel and Netlify via Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Nr4DuTI27CY https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tdzFX2u3dgA Gemini CLI Update: Session Persistence Automatic background session saving - every prompt and response is stored locally Use "gemini -res" to instantly resume the most recent conversation exactly where it left off Use /resume command within the CLI to open a searchable list of all past conversations, allowing users to jump back into specific workflows from days prior https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-luEGxUCbTA Google Anti-gravity + Open Code "conductor and lead engineer" workflow Anti-gravity good at planning Open Code is superior for surgical code changes and model flexibility Demo: using Anti-gravity (powered by Opus 4.5) to generate a complex implementation plan; Using Open Code as attachment to execute the plan (do the coding) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dzDVt3-MTRk

slides.title: Robotics muscles (actuators) Modern humanoid robots primarily use
slides.text: Robotics muscles (actuators) Modern humanoid robots primarily use rotating electric motors combined with gear reduction systems (like harmonic drives or planetary gears) as their main actuation mechanism for hands and feet These joint motors serve as the "muscles" of humanoid robots and typically account for over 30% of the overall bill of materials cost in high-performance humanoid systems https://www.roboticstomorrow.com/story/2025/06/joint-actuators-the-fundamental-component-for-humanoid-robots-power-and-dexterity/24924/ For legs, ankle joints typically have at least two actuators to control dorsiflexion/plantarflexion (pointing the foot up or down) and inversion/eversion (tilting the foot inward or outward) Some designs use linkage mechanisms where actuators drive knee joints through four-bar linkages rather than direct rotation The motors prioritize lightweight components with high torque density to minimize inertia and enhance agility while maintaining precise control https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fhRgwjEd3g8 Artificial muscle actuators research - soft actuators made from 3D-printed rubbers that can move and stiffen like biological muscle, In 2025, South Korean researchers created magnetic composite actuators that can lift approximately 4,000 times their own weight and achieve 86.4% strain (over double human muscle performance) by using tunable stiffness polymers with magnetic microparticles https://news.northwestern.edu/stories/2025/07/bone-ified-muscles-could-be-robots-next-flex Upper limb joints have reached consensus around harmonic drive modules, while lower limb joints still vary between harmonic, planetary, RV rotary actuators, and linear actuators based on screws A Deep Dive into Actuators for Humanoid Robotics https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FXC5ZFBefvs Rotary or Linear

slides.title: AI Updates Microsoft OptiMind-SFT (a.k.a. OptiMind) Open-source 20-B
slides.text: AI Updates Microsoft OptiMind-SFT (a.k.a. OptiMind) Open-source 20-B params MoE AI model, 128K context Converting complex business problems into formal Mixed Integer Linear Programs (MILP) and executable Gurobi Python code Optimization Expert-in-the-Loop: Microsoft trained the model using a "cleaned" dataset where human experts identified and corrected common mathematical modeling errors. The system supports multi-stage inference, where it classifies problems, provides self-hints, and uses a "solver-in-the-loop" approach to execute code and self-correct based on error logs. While it requires significant hardware (at least 32GB VRAM) and human oversight for safety-critical tasks, Optim-SFT aims to make high-level decision science accessible to non-experts https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9ZseQ-hXcp4 Google AI Edge Run AI models on mobile devices and microcontrollers without a cloud or internet connection Uses  TensorFlow and PyTorch Fast performance, improved privacy, and offline functionality across Android, iOS, and the web Low-code APIs for vision, text, and audio. LiteRT - optimized runtime for CPU, GPU, and NPU execution Model Explorer - visualizing and debugging model bottlenecks AI Edge Portal - A private preview platform for benchmarking models on over 100 real physical devices to track latency, memory, and battery drain Use Gemma LLM and multimodal apps, allowing businesses to ensure high performance on everything from budget phones to flagships before deployment https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-O-enNK6vYs

slides.title: AI Updates Cursor ran 100s of AI coding
slides.text: AI Updates Cursor ran 100s of AI coding agents for weeks In one experiment producing a 3M+ line web browser built entirely from the ground up using GPT 5.2 Cursor organized agents into planners, workers, and judges (similar to the viral Ralph Wiggum technique), allowing hundreds of agents to run and collaborate together The browser was built in under a week by the agents from scratch, with the final output actually loading simple websites correctly Other experiments included a Windows 7 emulator, an Excel clone, and an internal migration of Cursor's codebase, each spanning a Million+ lines of code OpenAI Updates $20 Bln in annual revenue $8/mo "ChatGPT Go" plan - uses GPT-5.2 Instant - fast cheap model Ads are being introduced to the Free and Go tiers Flywheel: - more usage leads to more data, which trains better models, driving more revenue to buy more compute. NVIDIA Nemotron-Speech ASR ASR = Automatic Speech Recognition Uses cache-aware streaming which only processes new audio "deltas" and stores past computations in an internal cache. 3x higher efficiency and zero latency drift under heavy loads; A 600M params model, outperforms larger models in both speed and word error rate https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=83DSjiLgWI8

slides.title: Deepseek Engram Deepseek Engram - Conditional Memory via
slides.text: Deepseek Engram Deepseek Engram - Conditional Memory via Scalable Lookup Engram is a conditional memory module that adds a new type of sparsity to LLMs alongside existing Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) approaches Unlike traditional Transformers that simulate knowledge retrieval through computation, Engram enables O(1) lookups using modernized N-gram embeddings, storing up to 27B parameters. The researchers discovered a U-shaped scaling law that optimizes the balance between neural computation (MoE) and static memory (Engram) Mechanistic analysis reveals Engram handles static reconstruction in early layers, effectively deepening the network for complex reasoning, while delegating local dependencies to lookups frees attention for global context, dramatically improving long-context retrieval (Multi-Query NIAH: 84.2→97.0) https://github.com/deepseek-ai/Engram/tree/main https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.07372 DeepSeek V4 Leak Evidence on GitHub suggests DeepSeek is preparing its next flagship model for a mid-February 2026 release Technical shifts in KV cache and FP8 support hint at a major architectural overhaul focused on efficiency and coding Microsoft VibeVoice-ASR Speech-to-text model, 9B params, 64K-token context window Transcribes up to 60 min of audio https://huggingface.co/microsoft/VibeVoice-ASR

slides.title: AI Updates Nvidia personaplex-7b-v1 A full duplex speech
slides.text: AI Updates Nvidia personaplex-7b-v1 A full duplex speech to speech conversational model that targets natural voice interactions with precise persona control. From ASR→LLM→TTS to a single full duplex model Conventional voice assistants usually run a cascade. Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) converts speech to text, a language model generates a text answer, and Text to Speech (TTS) converts back to audio Each stage adds latency, and the pipeline cannot handle overlapping speech, natural interruptions, or dense backchannels PersonaPlex replaces this stack with a single Transformer model that performs streaming speech understanding and speech generation in one network https://huggingface.co/nvidia/personaplex-7b-v1 https://www.marktechpost.com/2026/01/17/nvidia-releases-personaplex-7b-v1-a-real-time-speech-to-speech-model-designed-for-natural-and-full-duplex-conversations/ Emotion Computing Researchers in Japan published a framework that identifies human emotions with 75% accuracy using bodily signals (like heart rate) and visual data, rather than just text analysis. https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.08295 NousCoder-14B - Open Source Nous Research - programming model trained via RL by executing code in a sandbox and receiving rewards for success https://huggingface.co/NousResearch/NousCoder-14B

slides.title: Haystack, LangChain, LlamaIndex Haystack, LangChain, and LlamaIndex are
slides.text: Haystack, LangChain, LlamaIndex Haystack, LangChain, and LlamaIndex are three leading open-source frameworks for building LLM / RAG applications Haystack - production-oriented and enterprise-ready designed for large-scale deployments requiring robust document handling, stability, and compliance It features a modular, component-based architecture with strong metadata filtering and hybrid retrieval capabilities LangChain - orchestration and rapid prototyping It offers maximum flexibility for building complex agent workflows, multi-modal applications, and dynamic systems requiring sophisticated context retention and real-time updates LangChain has captured significant developer mindshare for experimentation LlamaIndex - pecializes in fast information retrieval with dynamic chunking and flexible indexing strategies, though it's more limited in scope than the other frameworks Recent benchmarks show minimal performance differences when using identical components All three achieve 100% accuracy with variation mainly in token consumption (Haystack most efficient at ~1,570 tokens vs LangChain's ~2,400) Framework choice depends on whether you prioritize production stability (Haystack), development flexibility (LangChain), or retrieval simplicity (LlamaIndex)

slides.title: Microsoft Research Job Market Predictions Microsoft Research Job
slides.text: Microsoft Research Job Market Predictions Microsoft Research Job Market Predictions. Transformation vs. Elimination. High-Risk jobs - White Collar (translation, writing, sales, customer service, coding) Low Risk - Physical/Human-Centric (construction, electricians, nursing, personal services) 2025 - Entry-level "extinction" and the initial 85 Mln jobs outsourced to AI globally (but 97 Mln AI related jobs have emerged) 2026 - Industry transformation (jobs losses in manufacturing, transportation, healthcare), but growth in AI-related management roles 2027 : The "Skill Revolution" where the divide between AI-literate workers and others becomes permanent. AI literacy becomes a mandatory requirement for high-paying roles; 70% of job skills globally are expected to change By 2027, workers with AI skills will earn roughly 56% more than those without Three strategies for workers: 1. Collaborate, don't compete: Use AI to handle routine tasks and move "up the value chain" 2. Focus on Human Skills: Double down on ethics, strategy, and emotional intelligence 3. Gain AI Literacy: Learn to prompt and manage AI systems to remain employable and access higher wages https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x3QSOXgxp6I https://arxiv.org/pdf/2507.07935 https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/research/publication/working-with-ai-measuring-the-occupational-implications-of-generative-ai/

slides.title: Boris Cherny about career trajectory Boris Cherny about
slides.text: Boris Cherny about career trajectory Boris Cherny about career trajectory Boris Cherny, creator of Claude Code, former Principal Engineer at Meta He progressed from a mid-level engineer to a high-level IC He emphasize the value of being a "generalist" and seeking "latent demand" - building products based on how users are already hacking existing tools At Meta Boris rose through the levels by taking initiative on high-leverage "side quests," such as creating internal state management frameworks (Undux) and leading massive migrations like the rewrite of Facebook Groups onto the Comet platform At Instagram - he moved to Tokyo to maintain his relationship, which inadvertently helped him avoid "meeting burnout" and return to deep coding, eventually leading the migration of Instagram's backend from Python to Hack At Anthropic - driven by a mission-oriented culture and a love for sci-fi, he developed Claude Code Boris argues that engineers should "build for the model six months from now ," not the model of today. He highlights that Claude Code has increased engineer productivity at Anthropic by nearly 70%, shifting the developer's role from manual coding to "orchestrating" fleets of AI agents His ultimate advice for engineers is to maintain "common sense" and focus on solving real user problems rather than just following organizational processes
